title: Data Type 오류 해결
markdown:
### Data Type 오류 해결
형변환 ( cast( … as 타입)) ```sql --숫자 형변환 cast(값 as decimal) --문자 형변환 cast(값 as char)) ```
ex) 형변환( cast() ) - rating: 문자 타입 → ABC ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/ae379ba3db9279e04fd12befb1b757091fbdbcb5/posts/1baeda9b-0fe1-8088-b0dd-e15be865307f/3d59510f8728f1d8.webp) ```sql --숫자로 변경 cast(if(rating='Not given', '1', rating) as decimal) --문자로 변경 concat(restaurant_name, '-', cast(order_id as char)) ```
